description: Have you ever seen that funny scooper toy that molds snow into adorable duckling shapes? That's what this is about. Probably.

name: Skull Board
description: Noxus' board of directors. Most of the time, they don't even give direction. They just shout "OW!" whenever you walk.

name: Skye Assassin's Field
description: Even stepping a little too close will give you quite the shock!

name: Slimiest Ground Rune
description: Ewww, it moves!

name: Smoldering Lion's Sigil
description: Ruled by the Sun, heroes who were born and battle under the Leo's star sign are recognized everywhere as passionate and creative. But much like the lion that represents them, they can be fiercely prideful when attacked.

name: Sol Invictus Rune
description: Through the swirling flames is a vision of an endless expanse of death and destruction. Beyond this, there is no future.

name: Sovereign's Radiant Eclipse
description: Once a guardian of Eden’s equilibrium, now a hollow vessel of ‘perfect order,’ the Crystallis Sovereign's purity has been corrupted by an… Anomaly. Their radiance remains, but its glare hides immaculate poise and a merciless heart. A fitting vessel to serve the Administration's highest purpose.

name: Spectral Ground Flames
description: Even the soul of an underhanded coward can take on the form of a relentless beast if steeped in enough curses and anguish. Death becomes a new beginning.

name: Spilled Slime (0 AC)
description: Not so much a tripping hazard as it is a sticking hazard. Start yelling. You're not going to be able to get out of this on your own.

name: Spilled Slime (AC)
description: Not so much a tripping hazard as it is a sticking hazard. Start yelling. You're not going to be able to get out of this on your own.

name: Spooky Center Stage
description: You have the floor, now make it count.

name: Spotlight Stage
description: Smells like a scene spirit.

name: Stabilized Time (0 AC)
description: Time doesn't always flow in one direction. Constant attention is needed to guarantee the steady motion of the clock's hands.

name: Stabilized Time (AC)
description: Time doesn't always flow in one direction. Constant attention is needed to guarantee the steady motion of the clock's hands.

name: Stage of the Soul
description: You've laid your soul bare on these simple pieces of paper. This is your stage.

name: Stained Glass Faerie Field (Ground)
description: Blue and purple, gold and green,

name: Stained Glass Faerie Grove (Ground)
description: Blue and purple, gold and green,

name: Star-Eater's Void Collapse
description: The Void of deep space snarls, and births forces of unbridled destruction.

name: Steampunk Geoforce
description: Steampunk Mages are the spearheads of the industrial revolution, turning towns and castles into well-oiled machines. Powered by something as simple as steam, their iron gears will conquer the land, sky, and sea.

name: Stormbringer Gust
description: A crack splits the sky and a harsh and terrible sigh spills forth.

name: Sugar Syrup Healing Station
description: Just a spoonful of sugar helps the medicine go down.. but do you REALLY want to ingest something brewed in Darkovia?!

name: Summer Seraph Rune (0 AC)
description: The undead will never rise from the land where you stand.

name: Summer Seraph Rune (AC)
description: The undead will never rise from the land where you stand.

name: Summoning Portal of Carnax
description: The Alpha are a cult of psionic sorcerers whose leader created Carnax in another timeline. Your task is to do whatever you can to protect and defend this creature… no matter where of when it appears.

name: Summoning Ring of Madness
description: From out of the darkness, you hear a whispered chant rise, and fear floods your heart and mind.

name: Surge Disruptor Charge
description: The crackle of electricity lingers even when you take your Surge Disruptor gear off.

name: Sword Spirit Summon Circle
description: A magic circle of cosmic incantations to call on the power of the star that oversaw your birth.

name: Symphonic Vibes
description: Music stirs the soul and gives color to dreams.

name: The Boatman's Approach
description: A familiar yet hazy arrangement of the Elements, both the foundation of the worlds, and a stranger to it.

name: The Crater Good
description: Never take your success for granite, or what was all your hard work for?

name: Time Telling Emblem
description: Constantly hopping from one era to the next can make you lose track of your own time. The Warden of Hours must keep themselves grounded, lest they literally end up lost to history.

name: TimeReaper Ground Rune
description: Where Drakath goes the TimeReapers follow. Have to help keep the timelines clean!

name: Timestream Ravager's Sigil
description: Those who can cross between times and worlds are the most dangerous of opponents. You never know where they will run to, or from which direction they'll attack!

name: Tomb's Mist
description: The sigh of an ancient tomb, finally allowed to breathe after ages of sleep.

name: Tormented Souls
description: Souls that couldn't withstand the forging process are ruined, and trapped in limbo. They writhe in the depths of the Underworld, and latch on to anything that can make them feel whole again.

name: Trickster's Grinning Stage
description: You're always hiding a smirk somewhere.

name: Trickster's Hidden Grin
description: You're always hiding a smirk somewhere.

name: Tundra Rune
description: The elder gods walk the frozen forests of the Northlands. Only their devoted warrior-priests know the ritual to summon them. But once they do… BEWARE!

name: Twilight Infinity Garden (0 AC)
description: Here lies a garden, beautiful but stagnant and unmoving. The petals will never fall, but more will never grow. Perhaps a small Dragon managed to escape from this nest.

name: Twilight Infinity Garden (AC)
description: Here lies a garden, beautiful but stagnant and unmoving. The petals will never fall, but more will never grow. Perhaps a small Dragon managed to escape from this nest.

name: UAP Beam
description: Some people still call them UFOs.

name: Undead Dreadspider Web
description: The bones caught in the Dreadspiders' webs have been emptied of their marrow. Their hunger knows no bounds.

name: Undead Lord Chuckles Aura
description: It's Chuckles' laugh that brings it all together.

name: Undead Lord Chuckles Rune
description: It's Chuckles' laugh that brings it all together.

name: Underworld Apostéllein Sigil (0 AC)
description: This rune carries a message from the Light. It was transformed in the Underworld's darkness, and began whispering Dage the Evil's will into the fallen's ears.

name: Underworld Apostéllein Sigil (AC)
description: This rune carries a message from the Light. It was transformed in the Underworld's darkness, and began whispering Dage the Evil's will into the fallen's ears.

name: Underworld Infiltrator Fractal
description: Softens your footsteps and hides your pulse so well that you can slip by Death themselves.

name: Underworld Recharging Ring
description: The Underworld Recharging Ring is used by Underworld Mecha Ghouls, members of the Futuristic Legion Optimization team deployed by Dage the Evil to assault Nulgath's forces.

name: Underworld Ritual Circle (0 AC)
description: A ritual circle that calls to the cold and dark depths.

name: Underworld Ritual Circle (AC)
description: A ritual circle that calls to the cold and dark depths.

name: Underworld Summon Ring
description: The Underworld Summon Ring is used by Underworld Mecha Ghouls, members of the Futuristic Legion Optimization team deployed by Dage the Evil to assault Nulgath's forces.

name: Underworld Territory
description: These banners are planted into the ground in areas the Legion has explored and conquered. Losing sight of them means you've trespassed on the unknown. Most disappear within seconds, and the Underworld keeps its secrets.

name: Underworld Tyrant's Arsenal
description: These weapons are made of Dragonbane, a material that can gravely wound their own master. Even Slaine's armor has Dragonbane spines that pierce his body. It stokes his hunger for battle, and makes him feel alive.

name: Underworld Tyrant's Enchanted Arsenal
description: These weapons are made of Dragonbane, a material that can gravely wound their own master. Even Slaine's armor has Dragonbane spines that pierce his body. It stokes his hunger for battle, and makes him feel alive.

name: Unending Light Aura
description: A powerful Light rune that grants incredible power with little sacrifice. The brightness of your future outshines and erases your past.

name: Uninvited Guest's Summoning Rune
description: DO NOT WANT

name: Unleashed Light
description: This isn't the sun's light or that of the Avatars. This comes from within.

name: Urban Serpent Decal
description: An ink snake that was brought to life by the power of your sick tunes.

name: Vampire Bat Emblem
description: Once bitten, you belong to the court of fangs.

name: Vengeance Pact (0 AC)
description: They turn to the gods of death, time, and revenge - or a dubious entity assuming a stolen identity - to heal their wounds. The price will be paid only when their justice is carried out.

name: Vengeance Pact (AC)
description: They turn to the gods of death, time, and revenge - or a dubious entity assuming a stolen identity - to heal their wounds. The price will be paid only when their justice is carried out.

name: Vinyl Stage
description: Not to be a broken record, but keep hitting that beat!

name: Virgo Changeling's Rune
description: Virgo Changelings are childen reared by fae, and sprites raised in human villages. Their sensitivity to nature and the nature of others bleeds into their magic. They manipulate the growth of plants, and the emotions of animals.

name: Void Cryomancer Rune
description: The cold comes from emptiness. Eventually, everything in the universe will go cold, and stop moving. These Cryomancers are a living glimpse of that fate, wielding frigid power that will eventually render them stiller than death.

name: Void Cryomancer Sigil
description: The cold comes from emptiness. Eventually, everything in the universe will go cold, and stop moving. These Cryomancers are a living glimpse of that fate, wielding frigid power that will eventually render them stiller than death.

name: Void Pyro Sigil
description: Fire consumes, and what it burns can never be brought back to the way it was before. Transformation through destruction is but another form of giving new life.

name: Void Recruit's Rune (0 AC)
description: Nulgath the ArchFiend calls only the strongest to serve him. To Become a recruit, one must be among Lore's greatest, most evil heroes. (CC to Accessory)

name: Void Recruit's Rune (AC)
description: Nulgath the ArchFiend calls only the strongest to serve him. To Become a recruit, one must be among Lore's greatest, most evil heroes. (CC to Accessory)

name: Void Rune of Deception (0 AC)
description: This sigil resembles others used in Nation sorcery, but it isn't in any of their scrolls. How did this sneak through?

name: Void Rune of Deception (AC)
description: This sigil resembles others used in Nation sorcery, but it isn't in any of their scrolls. How did this sneak through?

name: Voidseeker Fiend Rune (0 AC)
description: Warriors who sought out the Archfiend when they realized mortal bodies had their limits. Nulgath was more than happy to twist and mutate them into battle-hungry monsters.

name: Voidseeker Fiend Rune (AC)
description: Warriors who sought out the Archfiend when they realized mortal bodies had their limits. Nulgath was more than happy to twist and mutate them into battle-hungry monsters.

name: Volcanic Island (0 AC)
description: Molten rock drifts through the magma. Better watch where you step.

name: Volcanic Island (AC)
description: Molten rock drifts through the magma. Better watch where you step.

name: War's Aura (0 AC)
description: More like War's arena. The Horseman brings it with him wherever he goes. War can spark at any moment, after all. It's even better when he rides against one of his fellow Horsemen.

name: War's Aura (AC)
description: More like War's arena. The Horseman brings it with him wherever he goes. War can spark at any moment, after all. It's even better when he rides against one of his fellow Horsemen.

name: White Lotus Emblem
description: The rune is a spiral of petals, growing and dying. Flowers wilt. Snow melts. One's time is limited, so you must make it count.

name: Who's Clues?
description: Ask yourself: "If a guard dog fails to bark at the time of a crime… what does that mean? And how can it identify the criminal?"

name: Wolven Spirit of Depravity
description: Wolves hunt and kill to survive. This monster lies, tortures, and slaughters for joy. It makes its den in the hearts of the weak.

name: Wulf Creek
description: The water's cool, the shade is just right, and the tastiest honeysuckles grow right here. That's why the wolves lurk nearby, waiting, watching.

name: Year of the Rabbit Fountain
description: A ground rune perfect for the Year of the Water Rabbit, during the season of Spring showers.

name: Zenobia's BerryStain Splash
description: Zenobia was famous for the Moglinberry Juice served in her tavern. A wandering mage created this petrified juice splash as a centerpiece to recognize its deliciousness.
